item.title: [Hindi] [Web Series] Shaque: Trust No One
item.description:
Source91Mobiles Series
LanguageHindi
CategoryWeb Series
Release Date24 Sep 2026

The series follows a mother's nine-year-long, relentless search for her child who went missing as a newborn from a hospital. As she delves deeper into the mystery, her journey uncovers a web of dark secrets and shocking truths that make her question the intentions and trustworthiness of the people in her inner circle.
